metadata.title: Light and shadow in the Galactic Center - On the detection of the relativistic periastron shift of star S2 in the Galactic Center

notes: No star meets either contribution category. The paper's stellar targets are studied as stars orbiting Sgr A* (T:p4-b2; I:p4-b0), not as Galactic unbound candidates, and the paper makes no explicit unbound assessment for them.
